Class ArenaServer.HitCount

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.server.ArenaServer.HitCount
Enclosing class:
ArenaServer
private static final class ArenaServer.HitCount extends Object
Swings that reached the other fighter, by what they came to. A swing only counts as a hit of some kind once it has done damage; one that lands while the other is still flashing from the last hit does none, and is counted as that. The same way the training numbers are counted.
